name: What types of lighting are best for a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What types of lighting are best for a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a kitchen remodel, a layered lighting approach is often best, combining ambient, task, and accent lighting. Recessed lighting provides good ambient light, while under-cabinet LED strips are excellent for task lighting over countertops. Pendant lights can add both task lighting over an island and decorative accent. When planning, consider how each light source will contribute to overall functionality and aesthetics. We can help you integrate various types to create a functional and inviting kitchen space tailored to your East Bay home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Layered lighting, combining ambient, task, and accent lights, is best for kitchen remodels. Recessed, under-cabinet, and pendant lights are common choices.
